input.waitingFor: CI on pull request #302 finishes so the agent can merge or fix failures.

rationale: The CI run the agent was waiting on has finished, which is exactly the wait condition.

input.waitingFor: A maintainer approves pull request #302 so it can be merged.

rationale: The PR was closed without merge, so approval can no longer happen and the agent must re-plan.

rationale: The reply directly answers the question the agent was waiting on.

rationale: The deadline has passed without the condition being met, so the agent must reconsider rather than keep waiting.

rationale: The deploy is finished, satisfying the wait condition.
